en: Maybe I've been taking this too lightly.
Maybe part of me was simply expecting the other witches to come save me.
Ugh... I never thought I'd miss them.
Pull yourself together! This isn't over yet.
Another shard.
Good. The realms are complete...
And all my friends are here.
The preparations are already done. Getting a tea party ready is easier than I thought.
If they can't even do this properly, then this must be the real garden, right?
Unlike those fake witches, I will complete the tea party perfectly.
Because this is the real garden...
Oh, Fiena. Your body broke again.
It's all right. I'll make you again. I can do anything.
Because I'm Nahatra, the Dream Witch...
So this is how she came to believe this was the real garden.
Was there no one to stop her?
Imitating someone else's world at the cost of losing herself...
How about this one?
A true masterpiece. It should suit her well.
Good. Then what about this?
Hmm... Provocative.
What are you doing?
Ah, perfect timing.
Sil, come stand straight in front of me.
Why?
How dare you!
When I give an order, your only answers are "Yes" or "Understood"!
Yeah, yeah...
What is this about? I'm really tired right now.
No more complaints. Stand straight.
Hmm... Let's see...
Simple at first glance, yet remarkably layered.
Topaz? No, too plain. Turquoise? No... It needs to be softer...
...Are you evaluating me right now?
Your limbs are a little short for a model, but I can make it work.
Thanks for choosing your words so carefully.
Weren't we supposed to be making an artifact...?
An artifact this powerful must be custom-made.
I need time to understand what kind of witch you are.
So do your job as my model properly! This is part of the process.
Ugh... Fine, just make it quick.
Yes. Just stand still right there.
Hah!
Hmm, this isn't right.
Next!
Hmm, not this one either.
A true masterpiece indeed.
Sil, hold a proper pose.
I'd rather you focus on how it works than how it looks.
How dare you!
I will never allow such an affront to aesthetics!
If we don't, we may have to live here forever.
Hah...
Fine... It is not as though we have materials to spare.
If you want anything else, say it.
Hmm...
When I saw the Mirror Witch's memories...
She truly believed she was Nahatra.
She didn't even seem aware that she was imitating Nahatra.
She spent so long lost and confused, without even knowing who she really was...
If that was the only answer she could reach after all that suffering... isn't that tragic?
So could we use the power in these shards to reveal the Mirror Witch's true form?
Leave it to me.
Chloe's realm...
It was always a solemn place, but this one feels even colder.
Hmm, why is that? Maybe because there are no emotions in it?
It may look convincing, but it can't imitate the witches' deepest emotions.
Why... why does everyone keep breaking...?
The other witches... this garden... They should be perfect...
They're slowly falling apart...
Right... that's it. Witches come from outside the garden, form realms, and live there.
Then I'll have to bring witches here from "outside the garden" myself...
Then this garden will become more... complete...
So it really was impossible to maintain this world by herself.
The reflected realms, the witches, the tea party... all of it.
Hmm. So that's why she dragged us into this realm.
Looks like you brought the shard back safely.
Yeah.
It looks like this was the last shard used to create the witches' reflections.
Well done, Sil.
It seems we have all the materials now.
What happens now?
Now it's time for me to show what I'm capable of!
Watch closely from there...!
Phew...
Putting real effort into my craft again after so long has lifted my spirits.
Well? What do you think of my skill?
Oh~.
Hurry up and tell me what you think!
My thoughts? I don't really know much about this kind of thing...
Still, it looks impressive.
The shards are full of power, yet you've connected them without any resistance between them.
The flow of magic is incredibly smooth too. You really are skilled.
I thought you were all volume, but your hands are surprisingly delicate.
H-How dare you!
How dare you judge my work!
You told me to...
Hmph!
Now that you understand its brilliance, accept this artifact.
Accept it? How?
I am going to drive it into your body.
Sorry, but could we maybe try a different form instead?
You were the one who wanted the power to strip away the Mirror Witch's false appearance.
Merging with the artifact! This is the most reliable way to ensure peak performance.
B-But still...
Do not worry. The pain will only last a moment.
W-Wait! Fine, just give me a moment to prepare myself.
Hah... Very well.
I will begin the ritual on three. You count.
Yeah, yeah.
Phew... All right, let's do this.
I just count to three, right?
Oooone...
Haaaaah!!!
Hah, hah...!
You said you would do it on three...!
M-My arms and legs... They're all still attached, right?
Shasha?
Hah... hah...
I'm... fine...
You used too much power.
Do not push yourself any further. Leave the rest to me.
Thanks for helping me, Shasha.
...As long as you understand.
What will you do now?
I'm going to ruin that tea party.
...Hiyah!
Oh.
I can feel a connection between me and this mirror world.
It must be thanks to the artifact engraved into my body.
Now I might actually be able to stand against the Mirror Witch...
Be careful, Sil.
Everyone in the garden is worried about you.
Sure they are.
...Really?
Of course.
Everyone... is waiting for me.
Yes. Baking sweets and making tea as they wait.
By now, they may be holding the second memorial service.
There are cookies shaped like you too. Shall I bring you one?
...Just wait until I get out of here.
...Sil?
How did you... find this place?
You... should not be able to enter this place yet...
What are you doing?
Oh, this? The witches did not seem very enthusiastic about preparing for the tea party...
So I thought I would prepare a few things in advance.
Then I can make it into a more perfect garden. Yes... I can do that...
...What do these places look like to you?
They look very beautiful.
Don't they?
Do you not want to leave this place and see a real tea party?
Leave this place... a real tea party...?
What... does that mean?
I think I understand, more or less, how you ended up this way.
Projecting a witch like Nahatra is more than anyone could easily withstand.
What are you saying? I am... I...? I am...
Do not... confuse me...!!
So stop imitating other witches and come outside with me.
Stop...
This is not good for you or for the other witches...
Stop!!!
...I will make this place more perfect... That will fix everything, right...?
More living creatures. More witches...
I will preserve them all in this world, in more perfect forms...
Yes, Sil... I will do the same for you.
That w<style=glitchy>!@#%#</style>ould be so much better<style=glitchy>$%</style>
Right? Hehe... hehe...!
Ahaha...!!<style=glitchy>#@%$</style>
I had a feeling talking you down would not be easy...
No choice. I'll have to knock some sense into you by force!
Ugh... Aah...!!
So that is the Mirror Witch's true form...
N-No...
Someone... reflect me...
Pull yourself together. You're not Nahatra!
Then... we... no... I... who am I...?
How should I know?
You have not even told me your name yet!
I am... I am...
My name...
Yes. Your name.
Sil. My name is Sil.
Ugh, not good...
Is this the Mirror Witch's "projection"?
This must be the Mirror Witch's projection.
Now you're trying to project me?
Now I'm going to project you.
...Soon, you'll know who you are.
...I don't know who I am anymore.
Wake up already!
Everything you made here is nothing but a reflection.
The real garden is outside this place.
The real... garden...?
Look at me. I am not a reflection you created.
I am the real Thread Witch, from the garden.
If you want, you can come to the garden with me!
But... I was... so close... so close to having everything...!!
W-Wait. If we keep fighting, your realm will not hold...!
A-Anyone... reflect me...
F-Fill me...
Make me exist!!
Now...!
W-Whoa?!
The realm is starting to collapse!
Is that the Mirror Witch's real body...?
At this rate, the realm really will collapse...!
I have no choice... I have to save her...!
Ugh... my head...
What happened...?
You... saved me.
I almost got caught in the falling debris, but...
You shielded me...
I see...
...Where are we...?
...The boundary...
This is... the boundary at the edge of the realm...
You... finally came to your senses?
I-I don't know...
You don't know?
A-Are you really standing in front of me...?
You're not just another reflection I made up...?
What if I'm deceiving myself again...?
I'm real. I'm truly standing in front of you.
If you doubt me that much, look inside me.
An artifact made from your shards is embedded inside my body.
You and I are connected. You should be able to see my memories.
I-I can't believe it...
It's different from seeing through a mirror, isn't it?
Yes...
Nahatra used to get confused like you sometimes.
She would say things no one understood and cause trouble all the time.
I see...
I thought... if I projected Nahatra, everything would be all right...
My shattered realm, my body, even my mind...
But... all of this...
What have I done...?
What's your name?
Mary...
All right, Mary.
We should probably leave this realm now, don't you think?
My body is... starting to go numb...
Before things get really bad... could you open a way back?
I have to bring another witch out too...
I'm sorry...
Only a tiny fragment of what I used to be remains...
I no longer have the power... to send you back where you came from...
What...? You mean...?
...My body...
I'm sorry. I'm so sorry...
I will soon... too...
I found you.
You two are badly hurt.
...Nahatra...
You're late...
Hehe, sorry.
I could not reach the place where you were.
Naha... tra...?
Do not be afraid.
I know you only followed your instincts. Just like me.
B-But...
I... what I did...
You were confused because you reflected even the darkest parts of me.
Not because you are an inadequate witch.
Nahatra...
Yes. There is a saying for times like this. Um...
Wait a moment... I cannot quite remember it.
Chloe taught me a good phrase once...
Wait... that's enough... could you get us... out of here...?
I... am almost...
How dramatic.
Sil?
Oh, sorry. You really are at your limit.
Mary, I wanted to give you time to prepare yourself... but that does not seem possible.
So... imagine the person you want to become.
Who I want to become...?
Yes.
The garden is waiting for you.
Wow! I heard you were bedridden, and it's actually true!
I've never seen Sil laid up in bed before!
R-right now, she couldn't fight back no matter what we did...
Sil. Does it hurt?
Yeah. It really hurts. So please, just leave me alone for a bit...
She'll be feeling the aftereffects for a while.
She nearly got torn to pieces outside the garden.
If anything, she's lucky it ended with only this.
We should thank Nahatra for that~ Don't you think~?
Come in.
Oh! Everyone is here.
Sil certainly is popular~
I cannot believe Sil's home is practically a stable.
Shasha, that is generally considered a rather rude thing to say.
Maydel heard that Sil was hurt.
Maydel is very worried...
Sil's injuries will heal with time.
I'll explain the details over here.
Come in.
H-hello.
I came to see Sil...
Oh~ So that's the witch...
Sil~! Look who's come to see you!
...Oh. She's asleep.
Want me to wake her?
N-no! No... it's all right.
I only came to thank her.
I'll greet her properly another time.
Hmm...
The tea party will be held soon. You can introduce yourself properly then.
And since you had quite an impact on the garden, we'll need a chance to explain that too.
Come on, come over here~! There's nowhere to sit, though! Nahaha!
Ah, okay...
(What is everyone doing...?)
(Cramming into such a tiny place...)
(Still... somehow, it doesn't feel so bad...)
Ring... ring...
Hello?
Abigail?
...Who?
It's me, Sil.
I'm Abigail.
Click!
Wait, Abigail!
Ring... ring...
Abigail, don't hang up. Just listen...
Something serious is happening right now.
Yeah.
Fiena came to see me just now...
Yeah.
Something's off about Fiena.
Yeah.
I know Fiena is always weird, but...
Yeah.
This time she's even stranger than usual...
Yeah.
Are you not really interested in any of this?
Nope.
O-okay...
Anyway, make sure you're ready for the tea party. Okay?
Yeah.
Ring... ring...
Hello? Abigail?
...What is it?
I made you pajamas last time, remember?
Are you wearing it?
Yeah.
Phew, that's a relief.
I thought you might throw it away.
By the way, do you still sleep on a pile of straw?
Yeah.
I can get you a bed if you want. A nice, soft one.
Don't want one.
I guess it can't be helped...
Still, tell me if you ever want a bed or a pillow.
Yeah.
Ring... ring...
Hello?
What is it?
It looks like I'll be visiting your realm soon.
I called ahead so you wouldn't treat me like an intruder.
Anyone who enters the farm is an intruder.
Whether you tell me beforehand or not...
It doesn't matter.
I-is that so...?
Can't you make an exception?
Fine. Sil can be an exception.
Really?
Yeah.
If you say you'll live on the farm.
Th-that's...
I'll think about it...
Okay.
Ring... ring...
Hello? Abigail?
...What is it?
I'm calling today to pass on a message from Canele, not about me.
What.
Well... she says not to wring her out like a towel.
I've never wrung her out.
She says otherwise...
You did turn Canele into something like bread dough last time.
Or did you two have a fight?
It's just... because she's black.
Huh?
Crows are black.
Canele is black too.
I like crows.
So...
Oh, I see.
So that was your way of saying hello?
...Yeah.
Anyway, let's try to leave Canele alone.
She doesn't like being touched.
I'll make you a doll instead. A big one.
Don't need one.
O-okay.
Ring... ring...
Hello? Abigail?
Yeah.
Berry told me something...
You cut your hair with a sickle?
Is that bad?
It's not exactly wrong, but...
Why don't you come see me next time? I'll trim it for you.
No. Too much trouble.
Ugh... then I'll come to you.
All you have to do is sit still!
I'll bring milk candy too.
Okay.
Phew... You promised, okay?
...Yeah.
Ring... ring...
Hello, Abigail?
Abigail, can I ask you something?
...Yeah.
You looked taller the last time I saw you.
Have you ever measured yourself?
Don't know.
I guess you don't care...
Why do you ask?
Well, Nahatra keeps growing little by little...
But I don't think I'm getting any taller.
Yeah. Sil doesn't change.
Always small.
Smaller than me.
Hey, I'm not that short yet, okay?
Rims said I'm taller.
Don't believe anything Rims says.
Next time, I'll have Chloe measure us.
Next time?
Oh, I mean the next tea party.
See you then.
Yeah.
Ring... ring...
Hello.
Hello?
H-hey, Sil.
What? You were listening?
I-I thought some witch I didn't know might be calling.
I hate talking to people I've never met...
Oh, right. You're really shy around strangers.
It was so long ago, I'd forgotten.
Those were the days.
H-hey, shut up. Just tell me what you want.
Hmm~ Well...
A witch I didn't recognize came to my house.
I thought you might know something, so I called.
A witch you don't know?
Well, technically, I'm talking about Fiena.
She's acting a little... strange right now.
Fiena's always been kind of weird.
That's true, but...
Fiena's personality has completely changed. It's like she's a different witch.
I'm serious. Do you know anything?
Hmm...
Without seeing her myself, I have no idea. None at all. Hehe...
I see...
I guess I'll just get on with preparing for the tea party.
Ring... ring...
...H-hello?
W-who is this...?
It's me, Rims.
Oh, it's just you, Sil.
Yeah. It's nothing major, but...
It's about the dessert you two bring to the tea party.
I wanted to ask for the full recipe.
What is it, Sil...?
You're finally interested now...?
Heh, hehe... hehehe.
W-what? That's creepy.
I just thought I'd feel better if I made it myself, okay?
But... are you sure?
That sweet dessert you used to eat without a second thought...
Even if you learn what it's actually made of...!
B-because it contains the blood and flesh of sacrifices...!!!
Berry said it has meringue and wild berries in it.
...Oh. Yeah.
Well, if you add blood and flesh, it gains ritual power...
No, I don't need that part. I'm just eating it as a snack.
I'll write it down, so can you walk me through it?
Okay, whip it... And then? Mm-hm, mm-hm.
That should do it. Thanks.
Click!
Beep... beep...
Rims sounded a little down... Was it just my imagination?
Ring... ring...
Hello.
Hellooo, RIP Club speaking~
Oh, Berry?
I thought Rims would answer.
Oh, Sil?
So you were planning to whisper with Rims behind my back?
I'm a little jealous. Do you like Rims more than me?
Tell me, Sil. Me or Rims?
I just can't choose...
Because you're both the worst.
So it's a tie, then?
Your optimism is truly impressive.
Oh, thanks for the compliment.
So, what were you going to ask Rims?
You called for a reason, didn't you?
...What was it again? I know it was about the tea party.
You made me forget.
Call back when you remember. But...
Call me♡
Ugh...
Ring... ring...
Hellooo, R.I.P Club spea—
Tell me what you did to Fiena. Now.
Oh, Sil.
Coming at me before I can even say hello? Must be urgent.
Something is seriously wrong with Fiena.
Didn't you two do something to her?
Hmm? No. I don't know what happened, but this time it wasn't us.
Are you sure it wasn't you?
Maybe you put some strange curse on Fiena...
Honestly, Sil... Seriously.
Whenever something happens, do you always come looking for me first?
You must think about me all the time♡
...I'm hanging up.
Ring... ring...
Hellooo, RIP Club speaking~
I'm calling about the service provided by your club employees.
Oh, how may I help you?
Please tell your employees to leave me alone.
Hmm~ Maybe, if I feel like it.
I'm serious. Do something about it.
Sil, the dead are naturally drawn to the living.
It's a natural law that even I can't change.
All those laws together keep the garden in balance...
Isn't that beautiful?
Don't try to dodge the issue.
You could just give them an order.
Sorry. My employees can't suppress their instincts when they see someone alive.
Oh! I know, I have a good idea!
What is it?
You could become one of the dead too.
How about it? I'll give you a grave plot!
And if you act now, I'll throw in a headstone for free!
...Forget it.
Ring... ring...
Hello?
Berry?
H-hehehe...
Oh, Rims?
Wasn't this Berry's number?
Too bad, but Berry isn't here.
She's training the employees...
Employee training?
The dead lack common sense, so they need training...
They exchange sacrifices they brought... hold cursed rituals...
A-and they kindly teach each other how to use knives and saws.
It sounds like a social gathering when you put it that way.
Actually, that's exactly what it is...
It's also a chance to exchange contact details...
N-not that anyone would ever contact me anyway...
Just like you tried to call Berry instead of me today...!
Could you stop becoming so self-deprecating out of nowhere?
And if it bothers you that much, join the gathering instead of sitting there sulking.
Th-that's a bit...
The employees secretly look up to us...
I'm not the kind of witch who deserves that much expectation... It's too much pressure...
What are you talking about? You're a witch worthy of being invited to the tea party.
I don't know if you're a good witch, but you're definitely an impressive one, aren't you?
W-What's that supposed to mean...? Coming from you, Sil...!
I was trying to compliment you...
A-at the tea party, you'd better watch that neck of yours...!
Click!
Beep... beep...
She hung up.
Ring... ring...
Who is it?
It's me, Chloe.
Sil?
Is there a problem with the tea party?
Well...
Fiena is acting a little... strange.
Fiena is strange?
What shocking news.
I'm telling you, this isn't something to brush off.
So, has it caused problems for the tea party?
No, not really... not yet.
If anything, she seems more enthusiastic about the tea party than before.
I see. That's good news.
Anything else?
No, ma'am...
I just wasted time on a pointless conversation.
Ring... ring...
Who is it?
It's me. Sil.
I was wondering how Nahatra is doing.
So I thought I'd call before the tea party.
She's not much different from usual.
She seems asleep, yet awake at the same time...
She seems to be looking at us, yet also staring into empty space.
It's all documented in detail, so read the records.
Oh! Especially in Volume 320 of the Nahatra Observation Records...
Sorry, "she's doing fine" would have been enough.
Why does everyone avoid reading the records?
Maybe because there are hundreds of volumes?
The books are incredibly thick too. And every page is packed with text...
Then I should prepare a separate index and commentary guide.
Then everyone will read them diligently, right?
M-maybe...
Good. I'll start writing immediately.
Ring... ring...
Who is it?
Chloe, do you have a moment?
A moment, yes.
For this tea party, it's fine to prepare the same things as last time, right?
Why are you asking?
Well, the garden is changing little by little.
So I wondered whether the tea party really doesn't need to change at all.
Hmm.
The tea party was designed so we wouldn't have to worry about things like that. There's no need to worry.
...At least for a while.
How long is "a while"?
Or... if Nahatra grows more, or changes... what then?
That, I don't know.
So there are things even you don't know.
I know only what can be known.
Sil, remember this: knowing a great deal is not always a good thing.
There are concepts in the garden that must never be known.
I see.
But until you know you're not supposed to know it, how do you know...
Are you talking back to me?
No, ma'am.
And if you're so worried about the garden, try arriving on time for once!
Okay, okay.
